recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片一群細胞中有數顆核偏位、細胞質淡藍的漿細胞，其中幾顆細胞質含粗大紅紫色嗜天青顆粒（Snapper-Schneid顆粒），同時可見較大、染色質較細的不成熟漿細胞。
features: Cluster of plasma cells, some large and immature with dispersed chromatin and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm
Several plasma cells with coarse reddish-purple azurophilic cytoplasmic granules
Eccentric nuclei with perinuclear hof in the more mature forms
Admixed band and segmented neutrophils and fat vacuoles
Scattered free granules in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of plasma cells ranging from mature forms with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hofs to larger immature forms with dispersed chromatin and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm. Several plasma cells contain coarse reddish-purple azurophilic cytoplasmic granules consistent with Snapper-Schneid granules. Neutrophils and fat vacuoles are present in the background. Findings are compatible with a plasma cell neoplasm with azurophilic granulated plasma cells; quantitation and clonality studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Promyelocytes lack a perinuclear hof with clock-face chromatin, show Golgi pallor with nucleoli, and are MPO positive/CD138 negative.
Eosinophil precursors contain larger orange-red refractile granules with some dark basophilic granules and have granulocytic nuclear features.
Mast cells have central round nuclei obscured by dense purple-black metachromatic granules and express tryptase and CD117.
